summary: Able View Global Inc., a Cayman Islands foreign private issuer, furnished a 6-K reporting a Securities Purchase Agreement dated September 16, 2026 with an unidentified purchaser for 5,830,904 Class B ordinary shares at US$0.343 per share, an aggregate US$2,000,000, settling delivery-versus-payment and closing September 17, 2026. Shares were issued off an effective Form F-3 shelf (File No. 333-284994) via a September 16 prospectus supplement, with a Cayman counsel legality opinion filed as Exhibit 5.1. This is an ordinary shelf takedown, not a special situation; no board recommendation, advisor, premium or regulatory clock is disclosed. Watch for dilution and any follow-on pricing relative to the stated US$0.343 level.
